forum.title: Will the ST67W611M have BLE TMAP audio support?
forum.best_answer_content:
Welcome @ifa8, to the community!

The [ST67W611M1](https://www.st.com/en/wireless-connectivity/st67w611m1.html) is not intended for TMAP/LE Audio and does not include the requirements such as LE isochronous channels, host stack with generic audio framework, ASCS/PACS, or LC3 Codec.

However, you can use it as an NFC Secure Element and/or BLE Secure Element in a system solution with an LE Audio-capable host MCU/BLE radio chip that then implements TMAP, for example, the [STM32WBA](https://www.st.com/en/microcontrollers-microprocessors/stm32wba-series.html).

Does this answer your question?

Regards

/Peter
